mapper.select: SELECT d.channel_id AS "channelId", d.user_a AS "userA", d.user_b AS "userB", p.id AS "peerId", p.username AS "peerUsername", p.display_name AS "peerDisplayName", p.avatar_url AS "peerAvatarUrl", p.status AS "peerStatus" FROM dm_channels d JOIN users p ON p.id = CASE WHEN d.user_a = #{me} THEN d.user_b ELSE d.user_a END WHERE d.channel_id = #{channelId}
SELECT channel_id AS "channelId", user_a AS "userA", user_b AS "userB" FROM dm_channels WHERE user_a = #{a} AND user_b = #{b}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dm_channels (channel_id, user_a, user_b) VALUES (#{channelId}, #{a}, #{b})
mapper.select: SELECT d.channel_id AS "channelId", u.id AS "peerId", u.username AS "peerUsername", u.display_name AS "peerDisplayName", u.avatar_url AS "peerAvatarUrl", u.status AS "peerStatus", (SELECT max(m.created_at) FROM messages m WHERE m.channel_id = d.channel_id) AS "lastMessageAt" FROM dm_channels d JOIN channels c ON c.id = d.channel_id JOIN users u ON u.id = CASE WHEN d.user_a = #{userId} THEN d.user_b ELSE d.user_a END WHERE d.user_a = #{userId} OR d.user_b = #{userId} ORDER BY COALESCE((SELECT max(m.created_at) FROM messages m WHERE m.channel_id = d.channel_id), c.created_at) DESC
